# scripts/Interaction/Furnishings.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Interaction/Furnishings.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Procedural furniture with IdleSpot nodes used by guard habits.
Seat positions are floor-projected seat centres; yaw faces a seated guard
along local -Z. Static furniture uses world collision and nav_blocks
metadata keeps even low furniture out of baked walkable space.

Base: `RefCounted`. Registered class: `none`.
